newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Jan 7:
WASHINGTON - Raytheon Co announced plans to buy competitor Texas Instruments Inc's defense electronics division for $2.95 billion in cash.
WASHINGTON - The announcement that a presidential advisory council supports investment of Social Security payroll taxes in stocks could be the best news Wall Street gets all year.
WASHINGTON - More than 1,800 businesses moved out of the District from 1990 to 1995, twice as many as moved in.
DETROIT - Chrysler Corp unveils an experimental hydrogen fuel cell car it says is an important step to cleaner air.
